Fleet Sales

GWM is committed to expanding its presence in the fleet market, actively growing its customer base among small, medium, and large enterprises, as well as government organizations and state-owned enterprises. We also proudly support professionals in essential roles such as doctors, judges, police officers, and military personnel with dedicated mobility solutions.

As a “Global Intelligent Technology Company,” we put customers at the heart of everything we do—listening closely to their needs and delivering driving experiences that exceed expectations.

Driven by our mission of sustainability, we are advancing eco-friendly mobility by strengthening the electric vehicle ecosystem and working alongside Thai society to create a cleaner, greener future.

Together with our partners, GWM aims to grow with you and drive the Thai automotive industry toward a smarter and more sustainable tomorrow.
